notes: Legacy JSON blobs as Ito stores runner Codable values (library payloads and offline snapshots), captured from the ito-runner Codable models at f80d183 (ABI 1 and ABI 2 era) with a default JSONEncoder and sorted keys.
json is the exact stored text. Every blob must keep decoding under the current models, and re-encoding what was decoded must not change what an older reader sees.

blobs.name: chapter.abi1_era
blobs.describes: ABI 1 era: no kind, Float-encoded numbers, scanlator as a plain string

blobs.name: chapter.abi2_era
blobs.describes: ABI 2 era: kind stored by name, nil fields omitted; the number 10.1 was a Float

blobs.name: chapter.minimal
blobs.describes: only the key; every optional field was nil

blobs.name: chapter.float_numbers
blobs.describes: numbers that are not exact in binary floating point

blobs.name: manga.with_chapters
blobs.describes: ABI 2 era Manga with a chapter, as the library stores it

blobs.name: novel.with_chapters
blobs.describes: ABI 2 era Novel with a text chapter

blobs.name: anime.with_episodes
blobs.describes: Anime with an episode; its layout does not change in ABI 3

blobs.name: manga.without_chapters
